overview: Review one approved RTSP camera with NVIDIA real-time video captions, a live preview, saved observations and supervised monitoring goals.
target_users: Authorized camera operators and site reviewers.
capabilities: Review an approved RTSP camera with NVIDIA video-window captions.
Show live video separately from completed analysis.
Save timestamped observations and monitoring goals.
Keep decisions and physical actions with a human supervisor.
output: Timestamped sampled video observations and reviewable reports.

product.problem: Reviewing a continuous camera feed takes sustained attention.
product.benefit: Review concise camera observations with the original video intervals.
product.how_it_works: NVIDIA DeepStream and vLLM analyze video windows; the co-worker saves completed captions and serves a separate live preview.
product.input: One approved RTSP camera and an optional monitoring goal.
product.output: Timestamped sampled observations, reports and a live preview.
product.target_users: Authorized camera operators and site reviewers.
